response.overview: Elder Bicks When I got summoned to prove my devotion, I didn't know what to expect, but I knew I would do anything to earn my place in the brotherhood. I answered every question until he asked me about the guy at the rodeo. How did the president know about that? I knew I would be challenged so my thoughts could remain pure. What I didn't know was that to be cleansed, I would have to release all my dirty desires. How? By letting them come to life. It's only my first days in the mission well and I've already given in to temptation. Elder Dior, the man I answer to, loves to handle these cases. He knows just how hard it is for young missionaries to stay away from the pleasures of the flesh. It was time for my Ordination and I was willing to do anything to become a member of the Brotherhood. Besides, Elder Dior was running the ceremony. He's always made me feel cared for, even when he asked me to take off my clothes. Starring Nathan Bicks and Caden Dior.
response.title: Elder Bicks: Chapters 1-4
